integrity: A self-contained proof, seven-file source package and exhaustive small-case checker are supplied; computational enumeration is not invoked as proof of arbitrary finite-neighborhood completeness. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies to continuous shift-commuting pointwise group endomorphisms of the full two-sided quaternion shift, not arbitrary eight-symbol rules, infinite alphabets or other groups. Finite checks supplement a symbolic proof; historical priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: Central-shear automorphism group and order-four rigidity for \(Q_8\) cellular automata
